ratings_why.fun: The open-or-wait choice and Knock placement against a scouted board are real skill each turn, but the Spring build has little permanent growth late, so its curve flattens after Tier 4.
ratings_why.distinct: Untargetable hidden units that strike out of turn and a board you show that isn't the board you fight with feel new, though Lids and Underneath sit close to the Oozes' Belly.

verdict_why: One real rules gap: two "opens last" Lids (Corkhinge and Mabyn) can each skip the other, so the no-open-unit rule can stall.

points.text: If Signora Corkhinge and Grand Tyler Mabyn are your last two Lids, "opens last" skips each while the other exists, so neither opens. Say that when only opens-last Lids remain, the first in reading order opens.

The Sprung Trap build's only lasting growth is the Dew Gallery Orbweaver, and Nieces stay 3/3 all game. Let Brother Pardo Ashby's Nieces grow, for example +1/+1 permanently for each Lid that opened last fight, so the chain build keeps climbing late.

Patience only pays on wins, so Mabyn and Old Diadem are a winners-win stack and do nothing on a loss streak. A small loss-side payout (a Patient unit that opened in a loss keeps half its count) would give the build a way back.
Gossamer Jill fills every empty slot at Start of Combat, which leaves no room for Pardo's Nieces or other tribes' summons. Cap the Spiderlings (say three) or let a summon replace one.

standouts.why: The purse-web stab made into a card: it hits the enemy across every time that enemy attacks, and placement against the scouted board decides its value.
A capstone the Patience build is clearly built to reach, growing with how many Lids you kept shut.
An eighth body Underneath that turns another tribe's unit into the Lid's knock; strong cross-tribe glue.

weakest.why: Needs a winning board with two Patient units before it pays 1 gold, so it is dead on the turns economy matters most.
One +3/+3 to the next Spring is a thin Tier 3 job next to Tapwell and the Nemesia.
+2/+2 is low for Tier 3, and handing out a Lid only pays once the Knock chain is already built.

flags.note: Two "opens last" Lids together have no rule for which opens, so the fight can stall.
Grows with the square of Patient units, and shut Lids also count as survivors for hero damage, so a win streak snowballs on two fronts.
With Corkhinge and the Past Master it gains +4/+4 and +6 Attack per stab and is never hittable between stabs; the enemy's only answer is leaving the slot across empty.
Golden Worshipful Master with a golden Past Master replays every Spring six times; bounded to one fight, but worth the owner's eye.
